_note: Query 0b-1 (ownership probe; also the EBS playbook's Query 1, same call). State=available, Attachments=[] - but the tags are the point: kubernetes.io/created-for/pvc/name and ebs.csi.aws.com/cluster mark this as the backing volume of a PersistentVolume provisioned by the EBS CSI driver. A StatefulSet scaled to 0 leaves its PV's volume 'available'; that is NOT an orphan. Owner = k8s -> ❔ owned-by-k8s. The remaining delete-unattached-ebs.md queries are skipped.
